description: Configure how long moderation logs and leaver data are kept.

content.name: enablePingHistory
content.description: If enabled, the bot will keep a history of pings to enforce moderation actions.

content.name: pingHistoryRetention
content.description: Decides on how long to keep ping logs. Minimum is 4 weeks (1 month) with a maximum of 96 weeks (2 years). This is the length factor of the 'Basic' punishment timeframe.

content.name: deleteAllPingHistoryAfterTimeframe
content.humanName: Delete all the pings in history after the timeframe?
content.description: If enabled, the bot will delete ALL the pings history of an user after the timeframe instead of only the ping(s) exceeding the timeframe in the history.

content.name: modLogRetention
content.description: How long to keep records of punishments (1 - 24 Months). This is applied when moderation actions are enabled.

content.name: enableLeaverDataRetention
content.humanName: Keep user logs after they leave
content.description: If enabled, the bot will keep a history of the user after they leave.

content.name: leaverRetention
content.description: How long to keep data after a user leaves (1-7 Days).
